questions.stem: Why must people with diabetes carefully control their blood glucose levels?

options.text: Because high glucose levels can damage blood vessels, kidneys, and nerves over time
Because glucose is toxic to all cells at any concentration
Because the pancreas will stop working completely if glucose is too high
Because insulin production increases permanently with high glucose

questions.explanation: Uncontrolled high blood glucose can cause serious long-term complications including damage to blood vessels, kidneys, eyes, and nerves. This is why careful management is essential.
